verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way for users to define or schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows, such as scheduled reports, cron-style tasks or scheduled automations. Warehouse connector syncs and the marketing claim that agents 'monitor your product continuously' are adjacent features, not user-configurable recurring schedules. The MCP server and Query API are building blocks that would need an external scheduler, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
